units.text: IT之家 10 月 8 日消息，消息源 yeux1122 昨日（10 月 7 日）在 Naver 论坛发布博文，爆料称苹果正研发第二代超薄手机 iPhone Air 2，机身厚度由 5.6mm 降至 5.2mm（减少 0.4mm），同时采用更高能量密度电池，续航有望超越初代。
消息源称为实现“更薄且续航不缩水”，苹果并未缩小电池体积，改为研究更高能量密度的电芯方案，预估电池容量超过初代 iPhone Air（3149mAh），有望带来更优秀的续航表现。此外，这款手机预计还将保留钛金属边框，并采用与 iPhone 18 Pro 相同的“更小灵动岛”设计。IT之家附上相关截图如下：
影像系统方面，iPhone Air 2 将弥补初代仅单摄的短板，新增一颗 4,800 万像素超广角镜头，与主摄并列排布。主摄同样为 4,800 万像素，双 48MP 组合将显著提升拍摄灵活性。
核心配置上，新机预计搭载 A20 Pro 处理器、升级版 N2 无线芯片及苹果定制 C2 基带。三者协同可降低功耗、改善狭小空间内的散热表现。

evidence.discovery_lead: YouTuber Jon Prosser has stepped up his battle against Apple's lawsuit against him, in part by claiming he can't be accused of trade secret theft over iOS 26 now that it has long been released. Jon Prosser in a still from one of his Front Page Tech videos — image credit: Prosser It's now more than a year since Apple filed suit against Jon Prosser for allegedly obtaining trade secrets concerning what would become iOS 26. The delay has been down to Prosser missing court deadlines and then Apple agreeing to an extension following the birth of his new child. Now, however, Apple, Prosser, and his colleague Michael Ramacciotti, have jointly filed an update about the case to the court. And Prosser is using the delay to note that iOS 26 has been released publicly, so nothing he showed is a trade secret anymore. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

evidence.title: Tim Cook says ‘I’m not meddling’ in the new Apple CEO’s business

units.text: Tim Cook stepped down as Apple CEO in September, handing over the top job to former hardware chief John Ternus and taking an executive chairman role. Cook’s still a visible representative of the company, having been recently photographed attending a state dinner at the White House. But in an interview with The Independent, Cook says he’s “not meddling” in Ternus’ work.

“First of all, John and I have an incredible level of trust in each other,” Cook said. “The relationship must be based on trust, and the communication must be frequent and significant. But other than that, what I’m focused on right now is worldwide policy. And the interface with governments around the world matters because there are lots of things where we’re trying to advance or advocate for change. There’s a significant amount of work in that, and I’m doing that and helping John in any way he sees fit. I’m not meddling. I’m not a meddler.”

Cook also said he’s told Ternus to “make it your own job. Put your time in the things that you can add the most value to around the company. And that means don’t mimic me. Just like I didn’t mimic Steve. We all have different strengths.” (Ternus told staff that, based on advice from Cook, “I need to spend my time where I can add the most value for Apple,” Bloomberg recently reported.)

In the interview, Cook discussed how he wanted to make the leadership transition to Ternus “the best transition ever, a textbook example that people could look back to and learn from.” The transition “actually started years ago,” according to Cook, and he said that “I think everything has gone sort of exactly the way I had envisioned it.” Ternus introduced the iPhone Duo just days after taking over, and Cook said that he “wanted John to have some wind at his back.”

units.text: Apple is making more leadership changes as the John Ternus era gets underway. A new Bloomberg report today says Apple has named a new mergers and acquisitions chief and a new vice president of the App Store.
9to5Mac is supported by Sony: Sony is running a massive sale on its best BRAVIA TVs, ranging from its entry-level to flagship options — shop now to save!

According to the report, Apple has named Steve Smith as its new mergers and acquisitions leader. Smith replaces Adrian Perica, who joined Apple in 2009 and led the M&A and corporate development teams for over a decade. Bloomberg describes Smith as Perica’s “longtime lieutenant.” He will report to CFO Kevan Parekh.

Perica, meanwhile, is taking on a “more prominent position” within Apple’s services division. He has led iCloud, Fitness+, and Apple News since 2023 and will now report directly to services boss Eddy Cue.
In fact, Perica, along with Apple Music leader Oliver Schusser, is seen as a potential successor to Cue:

Though Perica is relinquishing responsibility for M&A, the move gives him a more prominent position within Cue’s organization at a time when the services chief is assessing multiple potential successors. Many Apple employees familiar with the situation believe Perica and Oliver Schusser, the executive overseeing Apple Music, are the leading candidates to eventually replace Cue. Another possibility under discussion is splitting Cue’s responsibilities between the two executives.

Additionally, today’s Bloomberg says that Apple is promoting Carson Oliver to vice president of the App Store, reporting to Cue. Apple Fellow Phil Schiller led the App Store until he stepped down in August.

units.text: 苹果正在进一步推动仍停留在iOS 26系统的iPhone用户升级至最新版本的iOS 27。据悉，从10月8日起，继续运行iOS 26的用户在“设置”-“通用”-“软件更新”界面中，将首先看到iOS 27.0.1更新包。此前处于主要位置的iOS 26.7.1则被移至页面底部的“也可用更新”栏目，以较不显眼的方式显示。
iOS 27于2026年9月14日正式发布。在过去数周时间里，苹果一直将iOS 26.7以及后续推出的iOS 26.7.1作为默认推荐更新，而iOS 27及后来的iOS 27.0.1则被放置在“也可用更新”区域，供用户自行选择安装。
如今苹果调整了两者的位置顺序，将iOS 27.0.1提升至最醒目的推荐位置，意味着公司开始更加积极地鼓励仍在使用iOS 26的用户升级到最新一代操作系统。
不过，苹果目前并未强制用户安装iOS 27。对于选择继续留在iOS 26的用户而言，安装iOS 26.7.1仍然是官方建议的做法，因为该版本包含最新的安全修复补丁，能够为设备提供持续的安全保护。
截至目前，苹果尚未公布iOS 27的用户采用率和升级数据，因此外界暂时无法判断这款新系统在全球iPhone用户中的实际普及情况。

如今苹果调整了两者的位置顺序，将iOS 27.0.1提升至最醒目的推荐位置，意味着公司开始更加积极地鼓励仍在使用iOS 26的用户升级到最新一代操作系统。
不过，苹果目前并未强制用户安装iOS 27。对于选择继续留在iOS 26的用户而言，安装iOS 26.7.1仍然是官方建议的做法，因为该版本包含最新的安全修复补丁，能够为设备提供持续的安全保护。
截至目前，苹果尚未公布iOS 27的用户采用率和升级数据，因此外界暂时无法判断这款新系统在全球iPhone用户中的实际普及情况。

evidence.discovery_lead: The Independent 's David Phelan on Wednesday interviewed Apple's executive chairman Tim Cook at Apple's U.K. headquarters in the Battersea Power Station, and one of the topics they discussed was John Ternus taking over as Apple's CEO. Ternus, who was previously Apple's hardware engineering chief, succeeded Cook as Apple's CEO on September 1 . Cook said the transition "started years ago." "It's been an interesting transition," said Cook. "We really set out to have the best transition ever, a textbook example that people could look back to and learn from. It actually started years ago. Obviously, these things are not quick things and I feel so great about how things are going. I think everything has gone sort of exactly the way I had envisioned it. And it feels fantastic. Because Apple deserved the best." Cook said that he stepped down on September 1, just eight days before Ternus unveiled the iPhone Duo , in part to give Ternus some immediate momentum. "I wanted John to have some wind at his back," said Cook. "And the wind at Apple is very much based on the product cycle. This product cycle feels unbelievably great. The Duo is coming in a few weeks and it's amazing." Cook had the seemingly impossible task of succeeding the legendary Steve Jobs as CEO. Jobs told Cook not to make a decision simply because it is what Jobs would have done, and Cook said that he provided Ternus with similar advice. "The advice I've given him is, make it your own job," said Cook. "Put your time in the things that you can add the most value to around the company. And that means don't mimic me. Just like I didn't mimic Steve. We all have different strengths." Apple and The King's Trust, a charity founded by King Charles III, on Wednesday announced an "immersive new education program to help young people build careers in the creative industries," with more details outlined in our previous coverage . Cook commented on the program in his interview with Phelan. "It's a way for us to give back in a way that is uniquely Apple," he said. "There are a lot of ways to do philanthropic activities, but I think you want to do ones where you can give part of yourself... not just your resource, but part of yourself, and we have such great creative people in the company that can be incredible mentors to these folks." Cook also touched on the new Apple Music Hall inside Apple's Battersea headquarters, describing the performance venue as "uniquely Apple." "I'm not sure there's a lot of people that could do it, and there's certainly not a lot of people that would. Every detail has been thought through, the construction, the design, the technology behind it, spatial audio capabilities: it's the perfect place to perform, whether you're a top-tier artist now, or an emerging artist, one that's just starting out. And it's a commitment to live performance and the recognition that that is so important." units.text: 苹果全球市场营销高级副总裁Greg Joswiak日前通过社交平台发布一段17秒的预热视频，正式预告苹果将于10月13日举行新品发布活动。视频中，两位参与者以刺绣方式制作经典苹果Logo，最后画面出现“Welcome home（欢迎回家）”以及“October 13（10月13日）”字样，明确指向即将到来的新品发布。
虽然苹果尚未公布具体产品名单，但此次活动主题被认为与智能家居生态密切相关。“欢迎回家”的宣传口号被业内广泛解读为苹果将把重点放在家庭场景产品之上。
根据目前流传的消息，外界最关注的新品是传闻已久的HomePad。这款设备被认为是苹果面向智能家居市场推出的新型控制中枢，可能承担家庭自动化管理、智能语音交互以及多设备协同控制等功能。
除了HomePad之外，新一代HomePod mini和新版Apple TV同样被视为最有可能亮相的产品。两款设备预计将获得硬件升级，并进一步强化与苹果人工智能和智能家居平台之间的联动能力。
与此同时，市场还传出苹果正在推进一系列家庭自动化配件计划，包括智能门锁、安防摄像头、泛光灯摄像机以及智能温控设备等产品。不过这些产品中部分可能由合作伙伴品牌推出，而不一定直接使用苹果品牌销售。
值得注意的是，本次活动的预告形式与苹果传统发布会略有不同。除了线上预热视频之外，苹果还向部分媒体发出了纽约活动邀请函，将于当地时间10月13日上午举行名为“Apple Experience”的体验活动。这表明苹果可能不仅安排线上发布内容，也会同步向媒体开放新品体验环节。
近期多个消息来源均显示，苹果正将智能家居业务提升到前所未有的重要位置。随着AI功能逐步融入家庭场景，苹果希望通过新的硬件产品打造更加完整的家庭生态系统，并扩大其在智能家居市场的影响力。
随着10月13日临近，苹果即将揭晓这一系列新品的真实面貌。而从目前释放出的信号来看，此次活动很可能成为近年来苹果在智能家居领域最重要的一次产品发布。

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple's iPhone Air 2 will be approximately 0.4mm thinner than the current model despite having a higher-capacity battery, claims the account " yeux1122 " on the Korean Naver blog. Apple lists the original iPhone Air at 5.6mm thick, so a 0.4mm reduction would put its successor at approximately 5.2mm, around 7% thinner. Interestingly, that would match the thickness of the new iPhone Duo when unfolded. A previous rumor claimed the iPhone Air 2 will feature a 3,500mAh battery . That's up from the 3,149mAh battery in the current iPhone Air, indicating around an 11% increase in raw capacity. The next-generation device is expected to launch early next year alongside the iPhone 18e and the regular iPhone 18. evidence.discovery_lead: Jon Prosser is arguing that Apple's alleged trade secrets are now public, while the company seeks his YouTube revenue records, channel analytics, and third-party messages to investigate his alleged financial gain from leaks about iOS 26 . In a new joint status report filed yesterday , Apple said it is still waiting for YouTube revenue reports, channel analytics, and third-party communications requested from Prosser more than three months ago. The materials concern his alleged financial gain and how Apple's confidential information was obtained and shared, continuing the discovery dispute detailed in August . Prosser's lawyer says he has already fulfilled the discovery obligations agreed to when the parties sought to set aside the default against him. He says Apple keeps requesting more documents each time records are produced. His attorney also argues that Apple's identified trade secrets are now public following the release of ‌iOS 26‌ and macOS 26, and questions whether some were ever secret given earlier third-party disclosures. He says Apple's written descriptions lack corresponding images, making its claims difficult to assess. Apple disputes that its disclosure is deficient and says it is willing to discuss it with the defendants' lawyers. It also says Prosser's deposition testimony and his Signal exchanges with Michael Ramacciotti suggest the pair coordinated to obtain and disclose confidential information for financial gain, contradicting Ramacciotti's denial of a conspiracy. Ramacciotti wants to distance his case from Prosser's defense, with his lawyer saying he is "unwilling to be drawn into it." He has asked Judge James Donato for an October conference at which Apple would explain what further evidence it needs, followed by a deadline within 30 days to dismiss its claims against him or commit to trial. He now conditions a second deposition and updated written answers on Apple first providing a roadmap to resolution. Apple filed the lawsuit in July 2025 , alleging that Prosser and Ramacciotti coordinated to access an Apple employee's development iPhone and profit from unreleased software information. Prosser published videos showing recreations of ‌iOS 26‌'s Liquid Glass redesign before Apple's announcement. Apple is seeking damages and an injunction against further disclosure of its trade secrets. In his July 2 response to the lawsuit , Prosser admitted participating in a FaceTime call during which Ramacciotti showed him features running on the development device. He denied participating in a coordinated scheme or that the information he viewed constituted trade secrets. If the court does not grant Ramacciotti's request for an October status conference, the parties plan to submit their next update on December 2. units.text: Leaker Jon Prosser Pushes Back as Apple Seeks His YouTube Data

Jon Prosser is arguing that Apple's alleged trade secrets are now public, while the company seeks his YouTube revenue records, channel analytics, and third-party messages to investigate his alleged financial gain from leaks about iOS 26.

In a new joint status report filed yesterday, Apple said it is still waiting for YouTube revenue reports, channel analytics, and third-party communications requested from Prosser more than three months ago. The materials concern his alleged financial gain and how Apple's confidential information was obtained and shared, continuing the discovery dispute detailed in August.

Prosser's lawyer says he has already fulfilled the discovery obligations agreed to when the parties sought to set aside the default against him. He says Apple keeps requesting more documents each time records are produced.

His attorney also argues that Apple's identified trade secrets are now public following the release of ‌iOS 26‌ and macOS 26, and questions whether some were ever secret given earlier third-party disclosures. He says Apple's written descriptions lack corresponding images, making its claims difficult to assess.

Apple disputes that its disclosure is deficient and says it is willing to discuss it with the defendants' lawyers. It also says Prosser's deposition testimony and his Signal exchanges with Michael Ramacciotti suggest the pair coordinated to obtain and disclose confidential information for financial gain, contradicting Ramacciotti's denial of a conspiracy.

Ramacciotti wants to distance his case from Prosser's defense, with his lawyer saying he is "unwilling to be drawn into it." He has asked Judge James Donato for an October conference at which Apple would explain what further evidence it needs, followed by a deadline within 30 days to dismiss its claims against him or commit to trial. He now conditions a second deposition and updated written answers on Apple first providing a roadmap to resolution.

Apple filed the lawsuit in July 2025, alleging that Prosser and Ramacciotti coordinated to access an Apple employee's development iPhone and profit from unreleased software information. Prosser published videos showing recreations of ‌iOS 26‌'s Liquid Glass redesign before Apple's announcement. Apple is seeking damages and an injunction against further disclosure of its trade secrets.

In his July 2 response to the lawsuit, Prosser admitted participating in a FaceTime call during which Ramacciotti showed him features running on the development device. He denied participating in a coordinated scheme or that the information he viewed constituted trade secrets.
If the court does not grant Ramacciotti's request for an October status conference, the parties plan to submit their next update on December 2.

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，本周三在接受《独立报》记者大卫 · 费兰（David Phelan）采访时，苹果前首席执行官蒂姆 · 库克（Tim Cook）表示，他于 9 月 1 日卸任 CEO， 部分原因是在 iPhone Duo 发布前 8 天，为继任者约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）创造有利开局。 库克表示，这次交接“数年前就已启动”。他说，苹果希望打造一次可供后人借鉴的“教科书式”交接，并称整个过程基本符合其预期。 IT之家翻译库克采访内容如下： 这是一次有趣的转型。我们一开始就立志要打造史上最佳转型，一个可供后人借鉴学习的教科书式范例。实际上，这项工作早在几年前就开始了。 显然，这些事情并非一蹴而就，但我对目前的进展感到非常满意。我认为一切都几乎完全按照我的设想进行。这种感觉棒极了。因为苹果值得拥有最好的。 特努斯此前担任苹果硬件工程主管，并于 9 月 1 日接替库克出任 CEO。库克称，他对交接进展感到满意，并认为苹果值得拥有最好的领导者。 库克还透露，他向特努斯提出与乔布斯当年给他的类似建议：不要模仿前任。他表示，领导者应把时间投入最能创造价值的领域，并按自身优势开展工作。 本周三在接受《独立报》记者大卫 · 费兰（David Phelan）采访时，苹果前首席执行官蒂姆 · 库克（Tim Cook）表示，他于 9 月 1 日卸任 CEO，部分原因是在 iPhone Duo 发布前 8 天，为继任者约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）创造有利开局。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，本周三在接受《独立报》记者大卫 · 费兰（David Phelan）采访时，苹果前首席执行官蒂姆 · 库克（Tim Cook）表示，他于 9 月 1 日卸任 CEO，部分原因是在 iPhone Duo 发布前 8 天，为继任者约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）创造有利开局。
库克表示，这次交接“数年前就已启动”。他说，苹果希望打造一次可供后人借鉴的“教科书式”交接，并称整个过程基本符合其预期。
IT之家翻译库克采访内容如下：
这是一次有趣的转型。我们一开始就立志要打造史上最佳转型，一个可供后人借鉴学习的教科书式范例。实际上，这项工作早在几年前就开始了。
显然，这些事情并非一蹴而就，但我对目前的进展感到非常满意。我认为一切都几乎完全按照我的设想进行。这种感觉棒极了。因为苹果值得拥有最好的。
特努斯此前担任苹果硬件工程主管，并于 9 月 1 日接替库克出任 CEO。库克称，他对交接进展感到满意，并认为苹果值得拥有最好的领导者。
库克还透露，他向特努斯提出与乔布斯当年给他的类似建议：不要模仿前任。他表示，领导者应把时间投入最能创造价值的领域，并按自身优势开展工作。

units.text: 苹果iPhone Air 2预计2027年春季发布，新机有望在进一步缩减机身厚度的同时，改善续航和影像表现。日前，海外爆料人士Sanju Choudhary曝光了iPhone Air 2的多项配置信息。据爆料，iPhone Air 2机身厚度将从现款的5.6mm缩减至5.2mm，比前代薄了0.4mm，但电池容量不降反升。
初代iPhone Air电池容量为3149mAh，而iPhone Air 2预计提升至约3500mAh，在机身进一步减薄的情况下，实现电池容量的提升。
散热方面，新机还有望首次引入VC均热板散热方案，改善超薄机身下的散热表现。
性能上，iPhone Air 2预计搭载苹果A20 Pro芯片，采用台积电2nm工艺，相比现款A19 Pro的3nm工艺进一步升级，内存则维持12GB不变。
同时，新机还将升级苹果自研C2基带，取代现款的C1X基带。
影像也将迎来明显升级，iPhone Air 2将告别后置单摄方案，升级为4800万像素主摄+4800万像素超广角双摄组合，进一步丰富拍摄场景。
屏幕方面，新机预计延续6.5英寸ProMotion高刷新率OLED屏幕，面板由M14升级为M16，并进一步缩小灵动岛面积。
从目前曝光的配置来看，iPhone Air 2的升级重点不再局限于机身轻薄，而是试图在超薄设计与实用体验之间取得更好的平衡，尤其是针对初代产品在续航、散热和影像方面的不足进行优化。

units.text: In a joint status report made public earlier today, Apple said it is still waiting on additional documents from Jon Prosser and wants to depose Michael Ramacciotti again, while both defendants pushed back on the company’s handling of the case. Here are the details.

According to a joint status report to Judge James Donato, Apple, leaker Jon Prosser, and Michael Ramacciotti are increasingly at odds over who is responsible for delays in the trade secret lawsuit Apple filed against both defendants in July 2025.
A bit of context

As a refresher, soon after announcing iOS 26, Apple filed a trade secret misappropriation lawsuit against Prosser and Ramacciotti over Prosser’s videos, where he leaked aspects of the system, including what turned out to be the Liquid Glass visual revamp.

Apple said Ramacciotti improperly accessed the development iPhone of an employee, who was later fired over the incident, and held a FaceTime call with Prosser to show him unreleased iOS features running on the device.

Since then, the case has had its own share of drama, with the clerk’s entry of default after Prosser failed to respond to Apple’s complaint by the deadline (although Prosser has disputed the characterization that he had ignored the case).
Then, eight months later, the court agreed to set that default aside and give him another chance to formally contest the allegations.
Court documents show that Ramacciotti, on the other hand, responded to Apple’s complaint and has largely cooperated with the company’s discovery requests.

Since Prosser retained representation and formally entered the case, however, things have taken a turn, with all three sides increasingly disagreeing over who is responsible for the alleged trade secret disclosure and for the delays that have followed.
The new joint status report

Back to the new status report, Apple says it wants Ramacciotti to update his interrogatory responses and sit for another deposition to address what it describes as “inconsistencies between his and Mr. Prosser’s testimony.”
Ramacciotti, however, says he will sit for another deposition once Apple provides “a roadmap to resolution of its claims against him, including what more, if anything, Apple needs from him.”

When it comes to Prosser, Apple says it “continues to await his production of certain additional documents that it requested over three months ago. These include revenue reports and data analytics for his YouTube channels and relevant communications with third parties that he identified during his deposition.”

Prosser, in turn, argues that “[i]t appears that the Trade Secrets at issue are no longer trade secrets and are in the public domain.” In other words, his argument appears to be that since Apple released the iOS update with Liquid Glass, the information at the center of the lawsuit is now publicly available and therefore no longer qualifies as secret.

As part of the joint status update, Ramacciotti asks the court to hold a status conference this month, at which Apple would be required to explain what additional information it still needs from him. He also wants Apple to then have 30 days to either dismiss its claims against him or commit to taking the case to trial.

Apple, meanwhile, wants discovery to continue, including a second deposition of Ramacciotti and the outstanding documents from Prosser. Prosser argues that he has already complied with the discovery obligations he agreed to and pushes back on Apple’s continuing requests for additional material.
If Judge Donato does not grant Ramacciotti’s request for a status conference, the parties propose filing another joint status report on December 2.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 8 日消息，爆料人士 yeux1122 今日发文，重申苹果 iPad mini 8 平板仍采用 60Hz OLED 屏幕。
他对此表示：“关于苹果 OLED iPad mini 的刷新率，部分海外消息源曾提到 120Hz…… 不过目前已经确认，国内生产机型采用的是 LTPS，就是 60Hz。”
同时 yeux1122 曾在 7 月份表示，新款 iPad mini 将配备一块 8.4 英寸的 LTPS（IT之家注：低温多晶硅）混合 OLED 面板，刷新率为 60Hz。作为对比，iPad Pro 使用的是双层 LTPO（低温多晶氧化物）OLED 面板，可实现 10Hz-120Hz 的自适应刷新率（ProMotion）。
如果此次爆料属实，那么不少期待 iPad mini 能上高刷屏的用户可能会失望。毕竟，考虑到 iPhone 17 标准版已经配备 120Hz 屏幕，可以看出苹果并不是有意将 ProMotion 技术与 Pro 高端型号绑定。
IT之家需要指出的是，上述消息仅是未经官方证实的传闻，我们仍然期望苹果能为新款 iPad mini 带来 120Hz 高刷屏幕。

units.text: Tim Cook Says He's 'Not Meddling' With Apple's New CEO John Ternus
In his new role as the executive chairman of Apple's board of directors, Tim Cook told The Independent's David Phelan that he is "not meddling" with Apple's new CEO John Ternus.

"First of all, John and I have an incredible level of trust in each other," said Cook. "The relationship must be based on trust, and the communication must be frequent and significant. But other than that, what I'm focused on right now is worldwide policy. And the interface with governments around the world matters because there are lots of things where we're trying to advance or advocate for change. There's a significant amount of work in that, and I'm doing that and helping John in any way he sees fit. I'm not meddling. I'm not a meddler."

units.text: 围绕苹果下一代MacBook Pro的传闻近日再次出现调整。最新消息显示，外界期待已久的OLED触控版MacBook Pro虽然仍有望在今年晚些时候发布，但此前广泛流传的“更轻更薄”设计可能只会兑现其中一部分，机身重量预计下降，而厚度方面则不会出现显著变化。
根据最新爆料，长期追踪苹果产品动态的彭博社记者马克·古尔曼修正了自己此前关于新款MacBook Pro的大幅瘦身预测。他表示，这款即将发布的产品最终可能不会比当前版本明显更薄。
这一说法与过去数月的市场预期形成对比。此前多次传闻称，苹果将在新一代MacBook Pro上采用重新设计的机身结构，与首次引入的OLED触控屏一同成为本轮更新的重要卖点。因此，许多消费者原本预期苹果会推出一款明显更加纤薄的专业级笔记本。
不过，虽然厚度变化可能不大，但减重计划似乎仍然存在。消息称，苹果已经重新设计了部分内部组件，并缩小了一些零部件体积，同时调整了内部结构布局，以降低整机重量和提升便携性。
目前尚不清楚新款MacBook Pro究竟会减轻多少重量。作为参考，现款16英寸MacBook Pro重量约为4.7磅（约2.13公斤），而15英寸MacBook Air重量约为3.3磅（约1.5公斤）。虽然MacBook Pro本身并不算特别笨重，但与MacBook Air相比，两者在日常携带体验上的差距依然十分明显。
除了重量调整之外，多方消息均认为，新款MacBook Pro最大的变化仍将来自显示技术升级。产品预计将首次采用OLED屏幕，并成为苹果历史上首款支持触控操作的MacBook。业内认为，这将是Mac产品线近些年来最重要的硬件变革之一。
与此同时，市场对于新机的发布日期也逐渐趋于一致。目前普遍预计苹果将在10月底至11月期间正式推出新版MacBook Pro，以纪念MacBook Pro系列问世二十周年。
虽然苹果至今尚未确认触控MacBook Pro的存在，但近年来不断出现的触控相关专利、显示技术升级传闻、新铰链设计以及macOS系统对触控交互功能的持续准备，都让外界相信这一产品已经距离正式发布越来越近。
从目前曝光的信息来看，新一代MacBook Pro或许不会成为苹果历史上最薄的专业笔记本，但通过OLED触控屏、更轻的机身设计以及全新的内部架构调整，仍有望成为近年来变化幅度最大的一代MacBook Pro。

evidence.raw_lead: iVerify released a report today detailing P7 DarkSword, a new variant of the malware associated with the DarkSword iPhone exploit chain uncovered earlier this year.
evidence.title: Researchers uncover new DarkSword spyware variant affecting unpatched iPhones - 9to5Mac

units.text: iVerify released a report today detailing P7 DarkSword, a new variant of the malware associated with the DarkSword iPhone exploit chain uncovered earlier this year. Here are the details.
A bit of context

Earlier this year, Google and iVerify revealed two sophisticated iPhone hacking tools known as Coruna and DarkSword, both of which chained multiple iOS vulnerabilities to compromise devices running outdated system versions.
In DarkSword’s case, once an iPhone was compromised, attackers could deploy additional malware with access to sensitive data.
Coruna targeted devices running iOS 13 through iOS 17.2.1, while DarkSword affected iPhones running iOS 18.4 through iOS 18.7.

This led Apple to release system updates for the affected older iOS versions, including iOS 15.8.7, iOS 16.7.15, and iOS 18.7.7. Apple went as far as to take the unusual step of making iOS 18.7.7 available to devices that could install iOS 26, so users who elected not to update to the latest system version would also remain protected against DarkSword.

At the time, Google said DarkSword was being used by multiple commercial surveillance vendors and suspected state-sponsored actors, with attacks observed against targets in Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Malaysia, and Ukraine.
New DarkSword variant found in the wild

Today, iVerify announced the discovery of P7 DarkSword, a previously unseen variant it found while investigating an infection on the iPhone of an employee at a financial institution just two months ago.

In additional details shared with 9to5Mac, iVerify noted that the P7 expands compatibility to iOS 18.7, up from iOS 18.6 in the earlier variant it had been tracking. Other DarkSword deployments observed by Google had already supported iOS 18.7.

The company also said the threat actor behind P7 is distributing it through malicious ads as part of watering-hole attacks, meaning victims do not necessarily appear to be individually targeted. Instead, users can be caught in broader campaigns simply by encountering malicious or compromised web content.
From the report:

In August 2026 we investigated a DarkSword infection that turned out to be a previously unseen variant, which we call P7 DarkSword. The name P7 comes from the threat actor’s use of the p7_ variable prefix in modifications to original DarkSword’s code. Compared with the variants we usually observe, P7 reduces its on-device footprint, adds on-device keychain and crypto-wallet theft, and adds two way C2 communication with the attacker’s infrastructure. This post describes the investigation, the variant’s capabilities, and the indicators that can be used to detect it._

The report says that P7 DarkSword improves on earlier variants in three main areas: stealth, stability, and functionality. The new variant reduces logging and the number of process injections it performs, uses browser storage to avoid repeatedly exploiting the same device, and expands its data-stealing capabilities.

iVerify also told 9to5Mac that the changes appear to reflect substantial work by the operators rather than simple AI-assisted modifications. The company says P7 is much better at hiding itself and cleaning up its behavior, so previous indicators of compromise (IOCs) are no longer valid.
Most notably, iVerify says P7 can extract Keychain data directly on the iPhone before sending it to the attackers, instead of copying the entire Keychain database for processing elsewhere.
P7 DarkSword can also target crypto-wallet data, and introduces more advanced two-way communication with the attackers’ command-and-control infrastructure.

That two-way communication also gives attackers considerably more control over an infected device. According to iVerify, P7 can receive commands to retrieve arbitrary files, upload photos, inventory installed apps, access Apple Notes databases, collect data from individual app containers, and scan the device’s filesystem.
By default, the spyware checks in with the attackers’ command-and-control server every 15 seconds for new instructions, although that interval can be changed remotely.

It’s worth noting that P7 is not a new iOS vulnerability, but rather a new version of the malware deployed after a successful DarkSword compromise. iVerify does not say which iOS version was running on the device where P7 was discovered in August.
To read iVerify’s full report, which includes technical details on how P7 operates, follow this link.

传闻中的触控OLED MacBook Pro将提供14英寸和16英寸机型，外形会比现有型号更薄、更轻，并在屏幕顶部加入灵动岛。产品仍被归入MacBook Pro系列；此前曾有可能改称“MacBook Ultra”的说法，但这篇彭博报道认为新机仍属于MacBook Pro家族。报道没有给出屏幕分辨率、亮度、芯片型号、内存配置、续航或价格等已确认参数，也未明确说明触屏OLED机型与M6 14英寸MacBook Pro之间的具体产品配置关系，因此这些细节不宜视为定案。

苹果的发布节奏可能分成两轮：彭博此前报道，公司计划于10月13日前后介绍新的智能家居中枢、Apple TV 4K和HomePod mini，月底再推出Mac及iPad新品。彭博称两轮发布都可能包含线上视频介绍和媒体现场体验，但尚无苹果官方确认这将是传统线下发布会。若消息属实，10月下旬的阵容还将包括M6版iMac；苹果此前也已表示，配备M5 Ultra芯片和512GB内存的高配Mac Studio计划在10月下旬上市。

evidence.title: IDC: Mac shipments drop 11% in Q3 as global PC market slides 20% - 9to5Mac

units.text: Despite seeing an 11% drop in Mac shipments during Q3 2026, Apple’s market share rose from 8.5% to 9.5%, as the broader market saw shipments plunge 20.1%, according to a new report from IDC. Here are the details.
Apple outperforms most of the PC market under challenging conditions
IDC today released a report on worldwide PC shipments for Q3 2026, noting that Apple significantly outperformed the broader market despite shipping fewer Macs than a year ago.
According to IDC’s preliminary data, Apple shipped 5.9 million Macs during Q3 2026, down 11.3% from 6.7 million in the year-ago period.
The overall PC market, however, fell much more sharply, with worldwide shipments dropping 20.1% year over year to 62.7 million units.
As a result, Apple’s share of worldwide PC shipments actually increased from 8.5% to 9.5%.

This kept Apple in fourth place, behind Lenovo, which topped the ranking with 14.9 million shipments and a 23.8% share, followed by HP with 10.3 million shipments and a 16.5% share, and Dell with 7.6 million shipments and a 12.1% share.

HP recorded the steepest year-over-year decline among the top five vendors, with shipments falling 30.9%. ASUS, meanwhile, saw the smallest decline, down 8.6% year over year, with 5.5 million shipments and an 8.7% share.
Here’s IDC:

Vendors and channels bought inventory earlier in the year ahead of price hikes, pulling demand out of Q3. Combined with continued supply constraints, that left the quarter without its usual seasonal lift and pushed shipments below both Q2 and last year.

Looking ahead, IDC says that “channel concern over high inventory and soft demand at elevated prices could bring promotions in the near term,” adding that “pricing will stay well above year-ago levels.”
The firm also says that the economy has weakened since the previous quarter, which could further reduce demand and “darken the outlook for the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.”
To read IDC’s full report, follow this link.

It's effectively a fact of American business. The latest shuffle is a slight reorganization, with mergers and acquisitions moving to a new person. According to a report on Thursday by Bloomberg, Steve Smith is Apple's new M&A head. Smith was formerly Apple's Senior Director of Corporate Development. Formerly, Adrian Perica held that responsibility, as part of his overall role which incorporates Services management. Reportedly, Perica will just be focusing on iCloud, Fitness+, and News going forward. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

units.text: Today Apple announced a special event happening next Tuesday, October 13 with the tagline ‘Welcome home.”
Apple launching new Home products on October 13, as teased by Greg Joswiak
Apple is launching new products next week on Tuesday, October 13, as hinted at in a teaser video posted by Greg Joswiak. Here’s the video from Joswiak, Apple’s SVP of Worldwide Marketing.
Welcome home. October 13. pic.twitter.com/ChelGSDOTI
— Greg Joswiak (@gregjoz) October 8, 2026
Apple is expected to launch several new Home products at the event, including:
New Apple TV 4K
‘HomePad’
HomePod mini 2
We’re also likely to see the leaked LG home accessories unveiled next week that Apple has reportedly co-developed with the company.
At the same time as Joswiak announced the date, invites went out to press for a special “Apple Experience” to happen in Tribeca, New York at 9:00 a.m. ET.
Here’s a look at the invite via Marques Brownlee:
Apple Home event invites just dropped. October 13 pic.twitter.com/gA5ephErP5
— Marques Brownlee (@MKBHD) October 8, 2026
View all comments
When Apple launched MacBook Neo earlier this year, it hosted a similar “Apple experience” for press. At the time, that unveiling followed multiple days of product launches via press releases.
Currently though, expectations are that all of Apple’s new Home products will debut the same day.
It’s unclear if Apple will have a full-length video introducing the products that debuts online at 9:00 a.m. ET, but we’ll keep you posted as more details emerge.
Which new Apple products are you expecting to see October 13? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，彭博社今天（10 月 9 日）发布博文，报道称新任首席执行官约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）再次推动苹果公司人事变动， 任命 Steve Smith 接替 Adrian Perica 出任并购主管，并将并购团队时隔 7 年重新纳入财务部门。 Steve Smith，图源：LinkedIn IT之家援引博文介绍，本次人事变动来自内部知情人士，苹果公司尚未对外正式宣布： 人员 新职务 / 职责 汇报对象 原职务或背景 Steve Smith 并购（M&A）主管 首席财务官 Kevan Parekh Adrian Perica 的长期副手，接手并购及企业发展业务。 Adrian Perica 继续负责 iCloud、Fitness+、News 服务业务主管 Eddy Cue 原并购及企业发展主管，任职超过 10 年。 Carson Oliver App Store 副总裁 服务业务主管 Eddy Cue 接管 App Store 日常管理，此前已承担相关职责。 Eddy Cue 服务业务主管，职权扩大 — 新增 App Store、健康及健身团队的管理职责。 在并购体系方面，Steve Smith 将接替 Adrian Perica，出任苹果并购主管。Smith 将向 CFO Kevan Parekh 汇报，这意味着苹果并购团队自 2019 年以来首次重新归入财务部门。此前，Perica 曾直接向时任 CEO Tim Cook 汇报。此次调整后，并购业务从 CEO 直属体系转入 CFO 管辖体系。 上图人物为 Adrian Perica 苹果并购及企业发展团队除收购公司外，也负责与外部企业谈判战略合作。该团队曾参与 2024 年苹果与 OpenAI 的协议，将 ChatGPT 集成至苹果产品，并涉及谷歌搜索在苹果设备上的长期默认安排。 在服务业务方面，Adrian Perica 卸任并购主管后，继续负责 iCloud、Fitness+ 和 News 业务。他自 2023 年起管理这些服务，今后向服务业务主管 Eddy Cue 汇报。Eddy Cue 的管理范围扩大，新增 App Store、健康及健身团队，让服务业务的核心管理权进一步集中到 Cue 管辖范围。 彭博社今天（10 月 9 日）发布博文，报道称新任首席执行官约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）再次推动苹果公司人事变动，任命 Steve Smith 接替 Adrian Perica 出任并购主管，并将并购团队时隔 7 年重新纳入财务部门。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，消息源 @itspdfu 昨日（10 月 8 日）在 X 平台发布推文，通过挖掘 iOS 27 代码以及分析 LG 设备固件，发现 LG 即将推出的智能门锁和恒温器等家居配件， 可能支持 HomeKit 独有的“未通电轻触设置”（tap to set up without power）功能。 这一功能可减少智能门锁、恒温器等设备初次安装时的步骤：用户无需先接电、进入配对模式或手动输入网络信息，安装体验更接近“贴一下即完成预备设置”。IT之家附上相关截图如下： 在用户体验方面，用户只需将 iPhone 18 Pro 等机型靠近设备，即可通过 NFC 预先写入配对身份和 Wi‑Fi／Thread 网络凭证；设备通电后自动入网，并由家庭中枢完成 Matter 配置。 技术实现方面，该流程基于 Apple 的 CoreHAP 私有 API HAPNFCReaderSession，与标准 Matter NFC Commissioning 分开实现。 在传感器方面，LG 门锁与恒温器固件中出现 NXP SE051H 安全元件；固件据称将 Matter NFC 小程序替换为 HomeKit 专用小程序，因此 NFC 预配置可能仅限 Apple Home。 消息人士通过挖掘 iOS 代码、分析 LG 设备固件发现，LG 即将推出的智能门锁、恒温器或支持 HomeKit 专属未通电轻触设置功能，简化安装流程。#智能家居# #苹果HomeKit#

在传感器方面，LG 门锁与恒温器固件中出现 NXP SE051H 安全元件；固件据称将 Matter NFC 小程序替换为 HomeKit 专用小程序，因此 NFC 预配置可能仅限 Apple Home。

units.text: iPhone Duo即将正式发售，苹果现已开始接收开发者使用Xcode 27.1编译、专为iPhone Duo优化的应用与游戏。以下为详细说明。过去几周，苹果陆续推出多个Xcode 27.1测试版，支持开发者为iPhone Duo编译、调试应用与游戏。今日，苹果正式发布Xcode 27.1第一个候选发布版（RC1），开发者可前往官网下载。
今晚早些时候，苹果在开发者新闻中心发布公告：开发者现已可以在App Store Connect中提交适配iPhone Duo的应用与游戏。
使用Xcode 27.1完成编译或重新编译后，App Store产品页面会自动显示专属标识，告知用户这款应用已针对iPhone Duo完成优化。
苹果同时明确硬性要求：从2027年4月开始，所有提交至App Store Connect的应用与游戏，都必须上传iPhone Duo设备截图。
在同篇公告中，苹果补充说明：仅需用Xcode 27.1对现有应用重新编译，即可获得iPhone Duo开发适配能力；开发者可借助设备模拟器（Device Hub），预览App在新机不同折叠形态、横竖屏状态下的运行效果。
苹果还提供了一系列配套资源，帮助开发者完成应用适配与商店页面素材制作：
1． 查看设计规范与模板文件
2． 管理App Store上架素材
3． 查阅应用预览视频规格
4． 查阅设备截图规格
未来数日，苹果还将举办多场iPhone Duo线下开发研讨会，可点击链接报名参与。
iPhone Duo将于10月16日（周五）开启预购，10月23日正式发货并线下门店开售。
苹果此前已宣布，用户可从10月12日起提前做好预购准备，相关详情可查看官方公告。

units.text: 随着苹果新一代iPad mini发布时间临近，亚洲供应链最新消息显示，这款即将发布的小尺寸平板预计将首次采用OLED显示技术，但屏幕刷新率可能仍维持在60Hz水平，而非外界期待的120Hz ProMotion高刷新率方案。
根据业内爆料信息，即将推出的iPad mini 8将搭载LTPS OLED面板，刷新率为60Hz。此前曾有部分市场传闻认为苹果可能会为这款产品配备120Hz显示屏，但最新消息称，已确认量产版本采用的是60Hz规格。
这并非首次出现类似说法。今年早些时候，供应链相关消息就曾指出，苹果计划在新款iPad mini上使用低温多晶硅（LTPS）背板OLED面板。这种方案虽然能够带来更高对比度、更鲜艳的色彩以及纯黑显示效果，但并不具备LTPO面板那样的可变刷新率能力。
目前，苹果iPad Pro系列采用的是更先进的双层LTPO OLED显示技术，刷新率可在10Hz至120Hz之间动态调节，实现ProMotion自适应刷新率功能。而LTPS OLED通常采用固定刷新率设计，在成本和功耗控制方面更具优势，但整体规格定位低于LTPO方案。
如果传闻属实，这一决定可能会让部分期待高刷新率的用户感到失望。尤其是在苹果已经将ProMotion技术逐步下放至更多产品之后，不少消费者原本预期首款OLED版iPad mini有机会同时获得120Hz显示能力。
不过，从苹果近年来的产品布局来看，公司依然倾向于通过屏幕规格区分不同档次产品。即便OLED显示正在向更多设备扩展，高刷新率技术仍然是苹果高端产品的重要卖点之一。因此，保留60Hz刷新率有助于维持iPad Pro与iPad mini之间的市场定位差异。
除了OLED屏幕之外，新款iPad mini预计还将迎来多项硬件升级。现有消息显示，该产品有望搭载性能更强的A20 Pro芯片，前置FaceTime摄像头可能调整至更适合横向使用的位置，同时升级扬声器系统，并提高整机防水性能。
发布时间方面，外界普遍预计苹果将在10月正式发布新款iPad mini。目前苹果尚未公布相关活动安排，但市场消息认为，新产品有望在本月底前亮相。
如果最终配置与目前传闻一致，那么新一代iPad mini最大的升级重点将集中在OLED显示技术本身。用户将获得更出色的色彩表现、对比度和黑色显示效果，但高刷新率体验可能仍需等待未来后续产品更新。

units.text: Apple TV just acquired the global streaming rights to Dustfall, a crime series from Australia and the second recent deviation from the streamer’s originals-only strategy.
Apple has started licensing more TV series, deviating from all-originals strategy
Ever since Apple TV launched in 2019, it rejected the typical streaming approach of licensing existing content and instead prioritized originals.

Apple has been remarkably consistent with its originals-only strategy. Until recently, the only exceptions have been children’s content that complement its originals (like Peanuts holiday specials), and limited-time bonus films.
But that changed this week, when acclaimed comedy Small Prophets premiered after Apple acquired the rights to the British breakout hit over the summer.
Small Prophets seems like a savvy acquisition. Early reviews call it a “masterpiece” and perhaps “the finest show to hit Apple this year.”
Now today, Apple has announced a second acquisition. Dustfall, an Anna Torv-starring crime series that originated in Australia, will join the streamer in 2027.
Like Small Prophets, Dustfall was created by an international production company and will air in select territories overseas before its global Apple TV premiere.
Clearly, Apple sees acquisitions differently than it once did.
While the streamer isn’t abandoning its successful original-first approach, licensing high-quality series from around the world to beef up its catalog is very much a strategic shift.
And it’s one I’m curious if we’ll see accelerate moving forward.
What do you think of Apple TV licensing third-party series? Let us know in the comments.
Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.

units.text: Apple is set to introduce a new MacBook Pro with a touchscreen and an updated iPad Mini “on or around” October 27th, Bloomberg reports. If true, that would put the event just two weeks after the October 13th event Apple announced today, which is rumored to focus on smart home products.

Bloomberg says that the late October event will include an “online video presentation” and an “in-person component for the press,” which it reports is similar to what Apple is planning for the October 13th event.

At this Mac and iPad event, Bloomberg reports that Apple will announce new MacBook Pros that are lighter than what’s available now, have touchscreen OLED displays, and iPhone-like Dynamic Island interfaces. Apple is also apparently planning to announce MacBook Pros that retain the current design but have the M6 chip introduced with the new Mac Mini. And the iPad Mini, which was last refreshed in 2024, will be updated to shift the front-facing camera onto the landscape side of the tablet and to add a “revamped speaker system,” Bloomberg says.

units.text: Apple’s redesigned MacBook Pro is coming soon, and the latest leak offers potentially great news for truly ‘pro’ users worried about the rumored thinner design.
Redesigned MacBook Pro will be much lighter, but not ‘significantly thinner,’ per Mark Gurman
The MacBook Pro has long attracted customers who may not be ‘pros’ in the sense of doing professional coding work, video editing, photography, or other tasks that require extra computing power.
Plenty of people want a MacBook Pro simply because it’s the best laptop Apple sells. It has the best display in a Mac, the most power, and the longest battery life.

But a new MacBook Pro design is coming, and previous reporting has said it will be thinner and lighter than the current model. Earlier this week Mark Gurman even said it will be “significantly” lighter.
That might sound great to ‘prosumers’ like myself, but it probably raises alarm bells for true ‘pros.’
Last night in a post on X though, Mark Gurman offered good news:
I don’t think it’ll be significantly thinner in the end
— Mark Gurman (@markgurman) October 7, 2026
Thinner, but not significantly so, while still offering a big weight reduction, sounds like exactly the right balance that should please most users.
If the new design doesn’t bring a drastic reduction in thickness, that’s good news for at least three reasons. It means the new MacBook Pro should:
Retain all or most of its existing ports
Offer battery life that’s not far off from current models
Have plenty of thermal headroom

Weight is generally a more common complaint than thickness with the current MacBook Pro, so if Apple can make the new MacBook Pro easier to carry, slim it down a bit, and still offer the kind of power and versatility pros need, that sounds like a big win.
What’s your take on the new MacBook Pro design based on rumors? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，市场调查机构 IDC 昨日（10 月 8 日）发布博文， 报告称 2026 年第三季度全球 PC 出货量为 6270 万台，同比下降 20.1%，较 2025 年同期的 7850 万台减少 1580 万台。 该季度出货量环比下降 9.1%。IDC 指出，第三季度通常高于第二季度，但本季度打破了这一季节性规律；这也是全球 PC 出货量连续第二个季度同比下滑。 原因方面，IDC 认为下滑的核心原因包括行业性提前备货。厂商与渠道商为应对内存驱动的价格上涨，在年初集中采购并囤积库存，提前消耗了本应出现在下半年的需求。 第三季度，渠道商主要消化上一季度已发往渠道的大量 PC。由于库存压力持续，市场未出现常规的季节性出货增长；供应受限、价格高企和物流中断进一步削弱了需求。 厂商表现分化明显。联想以 1490 万台出货量、23.8% 市场份额居首，但出货量同比下降 22.6%；惠普出货 1030 万台，同比下降 30.9%；戴尔科技出货 760 万台，同比下降 25.0%。IT之家附上相关图表如下： 排名 厂商 2026 年第三季度出货量（万台） 2025 年第三季度出货量（万台） 同比变化 2026 年第三季度市场份额 2025 年第三季度市场份额 市场份额变化 1 联想 1,490 1,930 -22.6% 23.8% 24.6% -0.8 个百分点 2 惠普 1,030 1,500 -30.9% 16.5% 19.1% -2.6 个百分点 3 戴尔科技 760 1,010 -25.0% 12.1% 12.9% -0.8 个百分点 4 苹果 590 670 -11.3% 9.5% 8.5% 1.0 个百分点 5 华硕 550 600 -8.6% 8.7% 7.6% 1.1 个百分点 — 其他厂商 1,850 2,170 -14.0% 29.5% 27.6% 1.9 个百分点 — 所有厂商 6,270 7,850 -20.1% 100.0% 100.0% 0.0 个百分点 苹果出货 590 万台，同比下降 11.3%，市场份额为 9.5%；华硕出货 550 万台，同比下降 8.6%，市场份额为 8.7%。联想、惠普与戴尔合计失去 4.2 个百分点的市场份额，降幅均超过市场整体水平。 参考 PC Market Woes Continue: Shipments Fall 20.1% in Q3 2026 as Pull-In Hangover and Supply Constraints Bite 市场调查机构 IDC 昨日（10 月 8 日）发布博文，报告称 2026 年第三季度全球 PC 出货量为 6270 万台，同比下降 20.1%，较 2025 年同期的 7850 万台减少 1580 万台。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，市场调查机构 IDC 昨日（10 月 8 日）发布博文，报告称 2026 年第三季度全球 PC 出货量为 6270 万台，同比下降 20.1%，较 2025 年同期的 7850 万台减少 1580 万台。
该季度出货量环比下降 9.1%。IDC 指出，第三季度通常高于第二季度，但本季度打破了这一季节性规律；这也是全球 PC 出货量连续第二个季度同比下滑。
原因方面，IDC 认为下滑的核心原因包括行业性提前备货。厂商与渠道商为应对内存驱动的价格上涨，在年初集中采购并囤积库存，提前消耗了本应出现在下半年的需求。
第三季度，渠道商主要消化上一季度已发往渠道的大量 PC。由于库存压力持续，市场未出现常规的季节性出货增长；供应受限、价格高企和物流中断进一步削弱了需求。
厂商表现分化明显。联想以 1490 万台出货量、23.8% 市场份额居首，但出货量同比下降 22.6%；惠普出货 1030 万台，同比下降 30.9%；戴尔科技出货 760 万台，同比下降 25.0%。IT之家附上相关图表如下：

苹果出货 590 万台，同比下降 11.3%，市场份额为 9.5%；华硕出货 550 万台，同比下降 8.6%，市场份额为 8.7%。联想、惠普与戴尔合计失去 4.2 个百分点的市场份额，降幅均超过市场整体水平。

units.text: 随着约翰·特努斯接任苹果首席执行官后持续推进领导层调整，苹果再次对核心管理团队进行重要人事变动。最新消息显示，苹果已经任命新的并购业务负责人，同时对服务业务和App Store管理层进行重新安排。
据报道，苹果已任命史蒂夫·史密斯出任公司并购与企业发展业务负责人。史密斯此前长期在苹果企业发展部门任职，被视为公司内部资深并购管理人士，也是前并购主管阿德里安·佩里卡的长期副手。此次升任后，史密斯将向苹果首席财务官凯文·帕雷克汇报工作。
苹果的并购业务过去十余年来一直由佩里卡负责。在他的领导下，苹果完成了多项关键收购交易，包括对人工智能、芯片、软件和服务领域多家企业的战略性投资与整合，使并购成为苹果技术布局的重要组成部分。
此次调整后，佩里卡将不再负责并购事务，而是将更多精力投入苹果服务业务。自2023年以来，他已经负责iCloud、Fitness+和Apple News等业务板块。调整完成后，他将在服务部门承担更重要的职责，并直接向苹果服务业务主管埃迪·库伊汇报。
报道称，在苹果内部关于未来管理层接班问题的讨论中，佩里卡被认为是服务业务领域的重要继任人选之一。许多熟悉相关情况的员工认为，佩里卡以及负责Apple Music业务的奥利弗·舒瑟，是未来接替库伊的主要候选人。苹果内部也曾讨论过另一种可能性，即未来将库伊目前负责的业务范围拆分，由不同高管分别管理。
除并购业务调整外，苹果还宣布晋升卡森·奥利弗担任App Store副总裁。奥利弗将同样向库伊汇报工作。
App Store此前长期由苹果资深高管菲尔·席勒负责管理。席勒于今年8月卸任相关职务后，苹果一直在推进应用商店管理团队的后续交接工作。此次奥利弗获得晋升，也被视为苹果进一步明确App Store未来管理架构的重要一步。
分析认为，自特努斯于9月正式出任苹果CEO以来，公司正在逐步完成新一阶段的管理层重组。与过去相比，苹果开始对部分关键业务进行更细致的职责划分，通过提升资深高管权限和培养下一代领导团队，为未来十年的业务发展和接班计划提前布局。
尽管此次调整并未涉及苹果产品研发部门，但并购、服务业务和App Store均属于苹果近年来增长最快、战略地位不断提升的核心领域。因此，这些人事变动被外界视为特努斯时代组织架构演进的重要信号，也反映出苹果正在为下一阶段的发展构建新的管理体系。

首先，我和约翰之间有着极高的信任度。这种关系必须建立在信任之上，沟通也必须频繁且深入。除此之外，我现在专注于全球政策。与世界各国政府的沟通至关重要，因为我们正在努力推进或倡导变革。这其中涉及大量工作，我正在努力完成这些工作，并在约翰认为合适的任何方面提供帮助。我不会干涉他。我不是那种会插手别人事务的人。
我也跟约翰说过同样的话。我给他的建议是，把这当成你自己的工作。把时间花在那些你能为公司创造最大价值的事情上。这意味着不要模仿我。就像我没有模仿史蒂夫一样。我们每个人都有不同的优势。

units.text: Apple is widely expected to introduce a new OLED iPad mini as soon as later this month. A sketchy new rumor today once again claims the new iPad mini will switch to OLED but still have a 60Hz refresh rate and lack ProMotion support.
OLED iPad mini might lack ProMotion

This is the second time we’ve heard this rumor, but both times it has come from the same source: the yeux1122 account on Naver. This account has a very mixed track record with Apple rumors. It often seems to regurgitate information from unnamed sources rather than provide its own.

Nonetheless, the latest post from yeux1122 claims “there is mention of 120Hz in some overseas sources” for the new OLED iPad mini, but “domestic production volume has already confirmed” it will use a 60Hz display.
Again, I’m treating this rumor with more than a healthy dose of skepticism, since no other reliable sources have corroborated it.
However, if it does come to fruition, this will be a disappointing limitation for iPad mini buyers. This iPad mini upgrade is expected to bring a number of other notable improvements, including:
An OLED display.
Apple’s A20 Pro chip, up from the current iPad mini’s A17 Pro chip.
A refreshed design with smaller bezels that could be more water-resistant.
The FaceTime camera will be relocated to the horizontal bezel, similar to Apple’s other iPad models.
If Apple made all those changes but stopped short of upgrading the display to ProMotion with a 120Hz refresh rate, it’d really sour the launch of the new iPad mini.
The new iPad mini is expected to launch later this month, so we don’t have much longer to wait to know for sure.
What do you think? Will the new iPad mini have ProMotion and 120Hz refresh rates? Let us know down in the comments.

units.text: Apple has just announced a new October event, taking place in New York on October 13th at 9AM ET. The company is rumored to be launching smart home-focused products this month, and the event invite hints that’ll be the case: Apple is using the tagline “Welcome home.”
[Media: https://twitter.com/gregjoz/status/2108226096407994858]

At the event, Apple is rumored to announce products including a smart home hub with a display, an updated HomePod Mini, a new Apple TV. The company is also reportedly teaming up with LG on new smart home devices that will launch at the event, including a video doorbell, thermostat, and indoor camera, and renders leaked yesterday that purportedly showed off some of those devices.

Apple has reportedly been working on a new smart home hub for some time, and apparently even wanted to launch it sometime in 2025. However, the delays to the upgraded, AI-powered Siri reportedly pushed that launch back. Siri AI finally launched in last month (though with a beta tag), and now that it’s out, it appears that Apple’s next big push for the smart home is about to begin.

units.text: Apple Has a New M&A; Chief as Ternus Reshuffles Leadership

CEO John Ternus is making changes to Apple's leadership, reports Bloomberg. M&A; is an important team at Apple, handling acquisitions and arrangements like the deal Apple had with OpenAI to add ChatGPT to Siri.

Perica will stay at Apple to oversee iCloud, Fitness+, and Apple News, which he has done since 2023, and will now report to App Store and services lead Eddy Cue. While Perica reported to Tim Cook in his M&A; role, Smith will report to Apple CFO Kevan Parekh as M&A; moves back to the finance division.

Carson Oliver is being promoted to vice president of the ‌App Store‌, and he has been in charge of the ‌App Store‌ since Phil Schiller stepped down from his role as ‌App Store‌ chief in late August. Oliver is reporting to Cue, who is now overseeing the ‌App Store‌ and other services.
According to Bloomberg, Cue is assessing potential successors, and Perica is a lead candidate. Apple Music lead Oliver Schusser is also in the running.

从宣传语来看，预计将发布苹果首款智能家居中枢产品。该产品此前被曝配备 6 英寸屏幕，提供壁挂与桌面两款形态。
IT之家综合此前爆料，桌面版整体外形类似 iMac G4，配有圆形金属底座，屏幕则通过金属支臂连接，用户可以手动调整俯仰角度；机身采用灰色铝制外壳，并通过 USB-C 接口供电。
壁挂版屏幕下方配有一块较薄的方形底座，用于容纳扬声器和麦克风，屏幕通过金属臂连接并可前后倾斜。两款正面均设 1080p 摄像头，用于 FaceTime、身份认证与人员识别。
两款产品均没有内置电池，需通过 USB‑C 持续供电。传感器可判断用户距离，无人时显示温度等信息，靠近时切换至控制界面。人体检测还可触发自动化，如进入房间自动开灯，并支持手势识别实现远距离操作。
系统方面，消息称该产品运行内部代号“Charismatic”的操作系统，发布时或称 homeOS，融合 tvOS、watchOS 与 iOS 元素。
运行界面类似 watchOS 与 iPhone StandBy 模式，闲置时突出表盘与照片幻灯片，主屏图标风格接近 Apple Watch。
硬件方面，为了支撑 Apple Intelligence 功能，这款产品预估采用 A18 或更高级别的芯片，且至少会配备 8GB 内存。
应用方面，苹果公司目前没有计划为智能家居中心创建专属的 App Store，该产品将预装 Safari、Apple Music、照片、日历、信息、提醒、FaceTime 等应用。
识别与隐私方面，摄像头精度不及 Face ID，因此辅以语音认证；用户可用 iPhone 进行二次认证提升安全性，并启用访客模式隐藏个人信息。
此外，苹果有望一同发布升级版 HomePod Mini、全新 Apple TV。据报道，苹果还将与 LG 合作推出新的智能家居设备，包括视频门铃、室内摄像头等。

units.text: Tim Cook visited Apple’s Battersea campus in London this week, mingling with King Charles as part of the company’s new partnership with The King’s Trust.
At Apple’s Battersea headquarters, Cook also sat down with The Independent for an in-depth interview on the partnership and his first month as Apple’s executive chairman.
Cook stepped down as Apple CEO last month, passing the torch to John Ternus. In this week’s interview, Cook outlined that the transition “actually started years ago.”

“It’s been an interesting transition. We really set out to have the best transition ever, a textbook example that people could look back to and learn from. It actually started years ago. Obviously, these things are not quick things and I feel so great about how things are going I think everything has gone sort of exactly the way I had envisioned it. And it feels fantastic. Because Apple deserved the best.”

Ternus’s tenure as CEO began with the launch of the iPhone Duo, which Cook said was fully planned. “I wanted John to have some wind at his back,” Cook explained. “And the wind at Apple is very much based on the product cycle.”

Cook also emphasized that he’s focused on “worldwide policy” as Apple’s executive chairman, noting the “incredible level of trust” between him and Ternus. While Cook is helping Ternus in “any way he sees fit,” he makes it clear he’s “not meddling.”

“First of all, John and I have an incredible level of trust in each other. The relationship must be based on trust, and the communication must be frequent and significant. But other than that, what I’m focused on right now is worldwide policy. And the interface with governments around the world matters because there are lots of things where we’re trying to advance or advocate for change. There’s a significant amount of work in that, and I’m doing that and helping John in any way he sees fit. I’m not meddling. I’m not a meddler.”
What kind of advice has Cook given Ternus? “Don’t mimic me.” You can read the full interview over at The Independent. It includes a great discussion on Apple’s new partnership with The King’s Trust.

units.text: Apple just announced a “Welcome home” special event for next week, but the fun doesn’t stop there. Bloomberg now reports that Apple is set to launch its first touchscreen MacBook Pros, a new iPad mini, and more “on or around Tuesday, October 27.”
The report says the launch will include “an online video presentation and in-person component for the press.”
Second Apple event of the month set for October 27
Among the new products on the docket for the late October launch are:

New 14-inch and 16-inch touchscreen MacBook Pro models with OLED displays. The new MacBook Pro models will also have a Dynamic Island for the first time and will be “significantly lighter” than the current models. These machines are expected to be powered by the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.
A new iPad mini with an OLED screen, a relocated FaceTime camera, and a “revamped speaker system.”
New iMac and entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro models powered by the M6 chip, which will “look like their current versions.”

Bloomberg explains that the launch will be “geared toward creative professionals who work in video production, photo editing and music production.” The report likens it to Apple’s launch of new Macs in October 2024, which included hands-on time for select members of the press in Los Angeles.
As is becoming clear, Apple has a ton of new products on the docket for this month. What are you most excited to see? Let us know down in the comments.

units.text: 快科技10月9日消息，网络安全公司iVerify于10月8日发布最新研究报告，披露了一款名为P7 DarkSword的iPhone间谍软件新变种。该程序在今年8月的一起DarkSword感染事件调查中被发现，相比此前版本，其隐蔽性、稳定性及数据窃取能力均有所增强。
根据报告，P7 DarkSword针对原有恶意程序进行了多项调整，包括移除HTTP请求及系统日志中的调试信息、减少进程注入次数，并利用浏览器localStorage机制防止设备被重复利用，从而降低恶意程序在设备上留下的痕迹。
在运行方式上，P7 DarkSword会注入iPhone的SpringBoard进程，默认每15秒通过/beacon接口向攻击者控制的服务器发送一次请求，以接收远程操作指令。攻击者还可以根据需要调整通信间隔。
获得指令后，该程序能够执行文件读取、照片上传、应用扫描、磁盘扫描及JavaScript代码执行等操作。
同时P7 DarkSword可以将iPhone钥匙串数据转换为JSON格式并上传至远程服务器，同时获取Apple备忘录数据库、应用沙盒文件以及指定路径下的其他文件。
此外，该变种还具备加密货币钱包扫描功能。研究人员发现，其内置的wallet_extract指令能够提取imToken钱包应用的相关数据。
值得注意的是，P7 DarkSword是已知攻击工具的升级变种，目前没有证据表明它利用了全新的iOS漏洞。披露的DarkSword攻击链主要影响运行iOS 18.4至18.7版本的设备，相关漏洞已经获得修复。
iVerify表示，P7 DarkSword的出现说明相关攻击者仍在持续改进恶意程序，在减少设备痕迹的同时进一步扩大数据窃取范围。对于iPhone用户，建议及时安装系统安全更新，降低此类攻击带来的风险。

units.text: After releasing a carrier settings update last week to address cellular issues affecting some iPhone 18 Pro Max users on AT&T, Apple is now rolling out a different carrier bundle update for devices running the iOS 27.2 beta. Here are the details.
Apple updates AT&T carrier bundle for iOS 27.2 beta

Last Friday, Apple confirmed to 9to5Mac that a small number of iPhone 18 Pro Max users on AT&T were experiencing an issue that could cause their devices to lose cellular service and become unable to make calls.

Apple said iOS 27.0.1, alongside a new carrier settings update, was meant to prevent the issue from affecting additional devices. However, iPhones that had already lost service would still require a hardware replacement.
Tonight, as spotted by Aaron Perris on X, Apple began rolling out another carrier bundle update for iPhone 18 Pro Max users on AT&T, this time specifically for devices running the iOS 27.2 beta.

Apple has just released an emergency carrier bundle update for AT&T users using an iPhone 18 Pro Max on 27.2 beta. Version 72.0.3 up from 72.0.2 This comes after Apple released 72.1 for iOS 27.0 users last week
— Aaron (@aaronp613) October 9, 2026

Reports of the problem first surfaced in late September, when some iPhone 18 Pro Max users on AT&T found that their devices had suddenly lost access to calls, texts, and cellular data, instead displaying “SOS” in the status bar.
Notably, the issue has only affected the iPhone 18 Pro Max, which uses a Qualcomm modem in the United States. The iPhone 18 Pro, which uses Apple’s C2 modem, has not been affected.
Apple’s carrier settings update released last week brought AT&T users on iOS 27.0 to version 72.1. However, users running the iOS 27.2 beta remained on the older 72.0.2 carrier bundle.
Tonight’s release reportedly bumps those devices to carrier bundle version 72.0.3, likely extending Apple’s AT&T carrier changes to iPhone 18 Pro Max users who are testing the iOS 27.2 beta.

evidence.title: 苹果 CEO 最爱的汽车品牌，要推出新超跑了

units.text: 苹果 CEO 最爱的汽车品牌，要推出新超跑了
在加州著名的拉古纳塞卡赛道跑进 1 分 40 秒，已经接近 GT4 赛车的水平。令人意外的是，跑出这个圈速的人不是职业车手，而是苹果这家科技巨头的 CEO 约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）。
这个成绩足以说明他的驾驶水平，当然也离不开座驾的出色性能——他驾驶的是一台全球限量 77 台的保时捷 935。
这台售价 150 万美元的跑车，正好符合特努斯这种顶级玩家对于「操控」和「小众」的偏好。而跑车，也即将成为保时捷的重点发展方向。
10 月 7 日，保时捷在魏斯阿赫研发中心举行了一场面向投资人的战略发布会，正式公布名为「Sportwagenschmiede’ 35」的新战略。这个看似拗口的德语词，直译过来就是「跑车工坊」。
在销量大幅下滑之后，保时捷决定告别过去，把资源重新集中到自己最擅长的跑车业务上。
保时捷 CEO 骆明楷（Michael Leiters）在发布会上表示：「眼下最重要的是降低成本，改善公司的财务状况。」他也坦言：「所有改变都不可能一蹴而就。」
从研发、生产到组织架构，保时捷正在经历一次全面调整。最先摆到台面上的，是大家最关心的产品布局。
拔高天花板，精简基本盘
自 2013 年发布的 918 Spyder 停产后，保时捷在顶级超跑领域沉寂了很久。在这份新战略中，保时捷终于确认将开发全新的中置超跑平台，并以此支撑定位高于 911 的旗舰车系。
相比传统的后置或前置布局，中置发动机能把车身重心置于前后轴之间，从而带来更快的车身响应和更高的极限。保时捷希望通过这一新平台抬高品牌的天花板，进入法拉利 296 和 SF90 所在的中置超跑市场。
▲ 保时捷 Mission X 概念车
重返超跑领域，不只是为了提升品牌声量，也有利润上的考量——站在产品金字塔尖的车型，既能摊薄前期研发成本，也拥有很高的溢价空间。
至于品牌的灵魂车型 911，保时捷同样有着坚定的立场。骆明楷明确表示：
911 绝不会变成纯电动车。
接下来，保时捷会继续拓展 911 的衍生车系，守住它在跑车市场的地位，同时为自己提供稳定的高毛利现金流。
保时捷此前已经在 911 Dakar 上尝到过甜头。这款「911 越野版」通过升高底盘、加入全地形驾驶模式和专属跨界套件，大大拓展了 911 的使用场景，也让保时捷看到，这一经典车系依然拥有很强的产品延展能力和溢价潜力。
跑车向上突破的同时，保时捷也重新评估了 SUV 阵营的上限，发布会上，他们亮出了一款全新的 E 级 SUV。
这里的 E 级，是欧洲对中大型和大型豪华车的分类标准。目前最顶端的 Cayenne 属于 D 级车，而这款规划中的新车定位将越过 Cayenne，向更高端的超豪华 SUV 市场发起冲击。
过去十几年里，Cayenne 和 Macan 几乎撑起了保时捷全球销量的半壁江山。面对日益分化的客户群，保时捷希望用这台空间更大、豪华感更强的 SUV，争取原本属于宾利添越、阿斯顿·马丁 DBX 和兰博基尼 Urus 的用户。
按照规划，未来几年，D 级和 E 级这两种高利润车型的销量将占到保时捷总销量的四成以上。
在高端市场向上突破的同时，主流基本盘也迎来了调整。
受到纯电 Macan 糟糕的市场反馈和全球电动化进程放缓的影响，保时捷决定为这辆 B 级 SUV 补上燃油和插混版本，与纯电 Macan 同台销售。其中插混车型将在 2028 年开始生产爬坡，预计会在 2029 年为保时捷贡献一定的销量和利润。
最后是传了好几年的纯电 718，保时捷也明确了它的量产时间——同样是 2028 年。
骆明楷表示，由于双门中置轻量化跑车对电池布局和散热提出了很高的要求，所以他们选择给研发团队留出充足的测试时间，届时，Boxster 和 Cayman 两款纯电跑车都将上市。
除了搞新车型、调整动力形式，保时捷还对现有车系进行了大幅度的瘦身。
在之前的快速扩张期，保时捷几乎每个车系都有着数不清的版型。以 911 为例，仅硬顶、敞篷和 Targa 三种车身形式，叠加基础版、S、4S、GTS、Turbo、GT3 等不同动力版本，衍生车型多达 20 余种。
再加上 Panamera 和 Taycan 复杂的动力与配置划分，保时捷的研发、供应链和整车工厂都承受着很大的运营压力，单车毛利也很难往上提。
为了改善这样的情况，保时捷计划把版型数量削减约 20%。据保时捷估算，版型精简之后，保留下来的主力车型平均销量预计将提高 30%。
保时捷要靠「厚利寡销」翻盘
特努斯用来刷圈的保时捷 935，正好能够说明保时捷是如何靠豪华跑车来赚取高毛利的。
2018 年，保时捷以 991 代 911 GT2 RS 的底盘为基础，搭配上后置 3.8 升双涡轮增压水平对置六缸发动机，推出了这辆最大功率达 700 马力的保时捷 935。
它有着全套碳纤维车身和夸张的空气动力学部件，外观几乎复刻了 1978 年勒芒赛场上被称为「Moby Dick 白鲸」的 935/78 赛车。更特别的是，这台车即不能上路，也不能参赛，专供特努斯这样的个人用户在赛道日使用。
尽管 935 是保时捷借助成熟平台重新开发的产物，研发成本不算太高，但加上限量和赛道日专用的稀缺属性，这辆车最终还是在藏家圈里卖出了极高的溢价。
在「Sportwagenschmiede’ 35」战略中，保时捷打算把这套高溢价路径进一步扩大：
将 Sonderwunsch 专属定制业务和经典老车翻新业务的营收提高到目前的 6 倍；
将 911、Panamera 等高端车系的平均售价提高约 20%；
推出更多高毛利的材质和性能选装包。
怎么说呢，虽说高端车型更贵了，但好消息是，我们兜里没这个钱。
▲ 图片中间的就是苹果 CEO 特努斯
保时捷之所以要强行提高毛利，原因无他：钱确实越来越难赚了。
2022 年保时捷刚上市时，营业利润率高达 18%，是欧洲盈利能力最强的车企之一。到了 2025 年，受到重组成本、资产减值和市场需求萎缩的连续冲击，公司的营业利润率降至 1.1%。即便销售回报率在 2026 年上半年逐步回升至 7.8%，距离当年的高点仍有明显差距。
其中，主力市场的收缩尤其明显。
中国市场曾是保时捷最稳固的销量支柱，2021 年交付量一度达到 9.57 万辆；到了 2025 年，这一数字只剩 4.19 万辆，销量几乎腰斩。为了应对需求下滑，保时捷中国在过去一年多时间里关闭了 40 多家门店，退网率超过三成。
好在跑车基本盘依然稳固，在 2026 年上半年，保时捷 911 的交付量逆势增长 19%，达到 30534 辆。
看到这样的数据，如果你是保时捷管理层，你大概率也会想：与其继续追求销量规模，不如主动收缩，把每台车的利润做到最大化。
为了扭转财务困境，保时捷启动了上市以来规模最大的组织瘦身。根据他们与员工代表达成的协议，到 2035 年，保时捷将累计削减约 9000 个岗位，相当于减少约五分之一的员工。
裁员主要集中在管理层和行政部门，管理岗位将削减约 40%，直接和间接职能部门的人员也将减少 25% 至 30%。
与此同时，保时捷也在维持工厂产能的稳定，承诺将祖文豪森和魏斯阿赫工厂核心员工的岗位保障延长至 2035 年，并在两座工厂投入超过 21 亿欧元进行技术升级。
而在研发和内部运转方面，保时捷把保时捷工程公司与保时捷数字公司合并成了「保时捷科技公司」，试图整合全球研发资源，减少不必要的沟通成本。
保时捷相信，这套几乎覆盖了汽车生产的各个环节「广进计划」，能够给他们省下很多很多钱，包括但不限于：研发成本最多降低 20%、生产的薪酬成本最多降低 30%、销售支出削减 20%，单车材料采购成本降低 10% 等。
总之，保时捷最终的目标是：确保盈亏平衡销量在 20 万辆以下。意思是，即使每年卖不到 20 万辆车，他们也不会亏。
除了削减人员和运营预算，保时捷也在不断砍业务，包括减持所持布加迪合资公司的股权，出售 Rimac 股份，卖掉 MHP 咨询子公司，另外还关掉了负责电池研发与生产的 Cellforce 公司。至于之前官宣的电动自行车和自主车载网关的研发，那更是想都不要想。

裁员、精简车型、砍掉副业，再把资源押回跑车和高端定制，最终都是为了守住保时捷最珍贵的东西——消费者对这个品牌的向往。

人们买保时捷，不是因为需要，而是渴望。

recorded_extraction: 苹果 CEO 最爱的汽车品牌，要推出新超跑了

在加州著名的拉古纳塞卡赛道跑进 1 分 40 秒，已经接近 GT4 赛车的水平。令人意外的是，跑出这个圈速的人不是职业车手，而是苹果这家科技巨头的 CEO 约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）。 这台售价 150 万美元的跑车，正好符合特努斯这种顶级玩家对于「操控」和「小众」的偏好。而跑车，也即将成为保时捷的重点发展方向。 10 月 7 日，保时捷在魏斯阿赫研发中心举行了一场面向投资人的战略发布会，正式公布名为「Sportwagenschmiede’ 35」的新战略。这个看似拗口的德语词，直译过来就是「跑车工坊」。 保时捷 CEO 骆明楷（Michael Leiters）在发布会上表示：「眼下最重要的是降低成本，改善公司的财务状况。」他也坦言：「所有改变都不可能一蹴而就。」 自 2013 年发布的 918 Spyder 停产后，保时捷在顶级超跑领域沉寂了很久。在这份新战略中，保时捷终于确认将开发全新的中置超跑平台，并以此支撑定位高于 911 的旗舰车系。

相比传统的后置或前置布局，中置发动机能把车身重心置于前后轴之间，从而带来更快的车身响应和更高的极限。保时捷希望通过这一新平台抬高品牌的天花板，进入法拉利 296 和 SF90 所在的中置超跑市场。
接下来，保时捷会继续拓展 911 的衍生车系，守住它在跑车市场的地位，同时为自己提供稳定的高毛利现金流。
保时捷此前已经在 911 Dakar 上尝到过甜头。这款「911 越野版」通过升高底盘、加入全地形驾驶模式和专属跨界套件，大大拓展了 911 的使用场景，也让保时捷看到，这一经典车系依然拥有很强的产品延展能力和溢价潜力。
受到纯电 Macan 糟糕的市场反馈和全球电动化进程放缓的影响，保时捷决定为这辆 B 级 SUV 补上燃油和插混版本，与纯电 Macan 同台销售。其中插混车型将在 2028 年开始生产爬坡，预计会在 2029 年为保时捷贡献一定的销量和利润。
最后是传了好几年的纯电 718，保时捷也明确了它的量产时间——同样是 2028 年。
在之前的快速扩张期，保时捷几乎每个车系都有着数不清的版型。以 911 为例，仅硬顶、敞篷和 Targa 三种车身形式，叠加基础版、S、4S、GTS、Turbo、GT3 等不同动力版本，衍生车型多达 20 余种。
为了改善这样的情况，保时捷计划把版型数量削减约 20%。据保时捷估算，版型精简之后，保留下来的主力车型平均销量预计将提高 30%。
2018 年，保时捷以 991 代 911 GT2 RS 的底盘为基础，搭配上后置 3.8 升双涡轮增压水平对置六缸发动机，推出了这辆最大功率达 700 马力的保时捷 935。
它有着全套碳纤维车身和夸张的空气动力学部件，外观几乎复刻了 1978 年勒芒赛场上被称为「Moby Dick 白鲸」的 935/78 赛车。更特别的是，这台车即不能上路，也不能参赛，专供特努斯这样的个人用户在赛道日使用。
尽管 935 是保时捷借助成熟平台重新开发的产物，研发成本不算太高，但加上限量和赛道日专用的稀缺属性，这辆车最终还是在藏家圈里卖出了极高的溢价。
将 Sonderwunsch 专属定制业务和经典老车翻新业务的营收提高到目前的 6 倍；
2022 年保时捷刚上市时，营业利润率高达 18%，是欧洲盈利能力最强的车企之一。到了 2025 年，受到重组成本、资产减值和市场需求萎缩的连续冲击，公司的营业利润率降至 1.1%。即便销售回报率在 2026 年上半年逐步回升至 7.8%，距离当年的高点仍有明显差距。
中国市场曾是保时捷最稳固的销量支柱，2021 年交付量一度达到 9.57 万辆；到了 2025 年，这一数字只剩 4.19 万辆，销量几乎腰斩。为了应对需求下滑，保时捷中国在过去一年多时间里关闭了 40 多家门店，退网率超过三成。

units.text: 快科技10月8日消息，有博主发文表示，iPhone Duo的第一批备货量比较少，应该是近几年苹果在中国大陆备货最少的手机。而且第一批iPhone Duo与第二批之间的间隔时间也比较长，这意味着首发阶段想要买到现货并不容易。
作为苹果首款折叠屏手机，iPhone Duo还没发布就引发了广泛关注。即便该机在配置上存在取舍，没有长焦镜头、Face ID，并且仅支持eSIM，依旧挡不住果粉的抢购热情。从目前的市场反馈来看，这款产品的热度依然居高不下。
不过，该机整机良率长期处于低位，首发货源十分紧张。据产业链消息，iPhone Duo由代工厂富士康负责组装，整机组装良率仅60%出头，远低于常规iPhone的成熟水准，接近四成产品不达标。
iPhone Duo的良率瓶颈主要来自核心部件铰链，这款铰链由上百个精密零件组成，初期零部件良率较低。再加上苹果坚持严苛品控，不愿放宽质检标准，因此良率爬坡至少还需要半年时间。短期内，产能很难出现明显改善。
受产能限制，iPhone Duo全年备货量已下调至600万台左右，首批现货供给严重不足。由于供需失衡，首发阶段大概率会出现高额溢价，消费者想要原价购机的难度极大。
值得一提的是，不少黄牛还以“第一天拿到现货”为幌子，提供代抢服务。售价方面，iPhone Duo起售价为15999元，将于10月16日开启预售，10月23日正式发售，提供256GB、512GB、1TB和2TB四种版本。

units.text: Apple released iOS 27 to everyone a few weeks ago, and it includes several CarPlay changes worth checking out. Here are a few changes I’ve been loving so far.
9to5Mac is supported by Sony: Sony is running a massive sale on its best BRAVIA TVs, ranging from its entry-level to flagship options — shop now to save!
CarPlay features to try in iOS 27
Siri AI

Siri AI is the flagship feature of iOS 27, and it extends to CarPlay. In fact, I’ve found it to be especially useful via CarPlay. Siri AI can answer questions around your personal context, world knowledge, and much more in iOS 27.
For example, you can ask Siri to find a specific address or location in your email or text messages, then begin routing to that location, all while using just your voice.
Robust, hands-free control is important in the car, and iOS 27 finally gives Siri the power that it deserves in CarPlay.
Now Playing changes
CarPlay in iOS 27 offers a persistent “Now Playing” MiniPlayer throughout audio apps. This appears in the upper-right corner of the interface and shows playback controls and album artwork.

The Now Playing interface in CarPlay has also been updated to include an audio scrubber at long last. You can drag the scrubber to easily skip to different parts of a song or podcast without using steering wheel controls or reaching for your iPhone.
New wallpapers
CarPlay isn’t known for its robust collection of wallpapers, and Apple doesn’t let you use your own photos for some reason.
In iOS 27, Apple has at least added a collection of new wallpapers that you can choose from. They are similar to the stock iOS 27 wallpapers available on iPhone.
Stability improvements
iOS 27 focuses a lot on platform improvements to performance and reliability, and that applies to CarPlay too. Apple says iOS 27 addresses two key things in CarPlay:
Improved navigation heading and GPS accuracy in CarPlay
Improved wireless CarPlay reliability
So if you’ve ever had problems with those two things in CarPlay, it’s possible that iOS 27 makes the experience much better.
Coming soon(ish): Video app support

Finally, Apple says that developers can now make dedicated video apps for CarPlay in iOS 27. The feature, however, requires support from automakers. This means it might be a while before you can actually use any video apps with CarPlay in your vehicle.
Wrap up
While the dream for many people is still CarPlay Ultra, it’s really nice to see Apple make meaningful improvements to the version of CarPlay already available in millions of cars on the road today.
Have you updated to iOS 27? What CarPlay changes have you noticed? Let us know down in the comments.
